entities.name: Javier Lozasno Alarcón
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Javier Lozano Alarcón is a Mexican politician who served Secretary of Labor in the cabinet of President Felipe Calderón. He was elected as a senator to the LXII Legislature of the Mexican Congress, representing Puebla. He then resigned from the PAN and worked in the campaign of presidential candidate José Antonio Meade Kuribreña.
